51056349.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human N-His-tagged BRD4 bromodomain 1 by surface plasmon resonance analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. The human N-His-tagged BRD4 bromodomain 1 (residues 1–135) was immobilized on the chip via amine coupling. The ligands were dissolved in HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20) and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM. The association phase lasted 120 s, followed by a 120 s dissociation phase. Regeneration was achieved with 10 mM glycine-HCl (pH 2.0). Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software. The KD values were determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 binding model.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20)
